two_factor.backup_code_description: Enter one of your 8-character backup codes. Each code can only be used once.

two_factor.title: Two-factor authentication
two_factor.scope: Applies to password sign-ins. Google or GitHub sign-ins use that account’s own security.
two_factor.status_failed: Couldn’t check your two-factor authentication status.
two_factor.password_required: Set a password first — two-factor protects password sign-ins
two_factor.backup_unavailable: Created when you set up an authenticator app
two_factor.regenerate_description: Enter your current password to replace your backup codes. Any unused codes will stop working.
two_factor.regenerate_stale: Your two-factor settings changed. Check their current status and try again.
two_factor.regenerate_failed: Couldn’t regenerate backup codes. Please try again.
two_factor.password_description: Enter your current password to set up an authenticator app.
two_factor.verify_description: Scan the QR code or enter the setup key in your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it generates.
two_factor.qr_alt: QR code for adding this account to your authenticator app
two_factor.copy_failed: Couldn’t copy. You can select and copy the text manually.
two_factor.code_format: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
two_factor.invalid_code: That code didn’t match. Check your authenticator app and try again.
two_factor.setup_failed: Couldn’t start authenticator setup. Please try again.
two_factor.setup_expired: This setup is no longer available. Start again to get a new key.
two_factor.verify_failed: Couldn’t verify the authenticator code. Please try again.
two_factor.backup_description: Store these codes somewhere safe. Each code can be used once if you lose access to your authenticator app. You won’t see these codes again.
two_factor.disable_description: Enter your current password to confirm. You’ll no longer need a code at password sign-in, and your backup codes will stop working.
two_factor.disable_failed: Couldn’t disable two-factor authentication. Please try again.
